summary:
## Standing operator rules
- Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.
- Never modify files under ledgerly/customer_export/ without posting the proposed diff in #privacy-review and receiving approval from @mina.
- FYI the staging Redis moved to cache-eu-3 after the incident; cache-eu-1 is being drained and must not receive writes. Use cache-eu-3 for anything staging.
- please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix the tax calculation for Canadian provinces in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py` for Quebec (QST). OpenTelemetry tracing is paused/superseded and has not begun.

## Ruled-out approaches
- A command-specific `--currency` argument in `build_invoice_list_parser()` duplicated the shared billing filter option.
- Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours made stuck jobs invisible for hours; do not retry.

## Recent work
Search rebuilding was optimized across all entry points: tenant-scoped queries use `Invoice.for_tenant`, the management command shares its `EmbeddingClient`, vector storage uses transactional bulk upserts, and migration `0042` adds a unique `(tenant_id, document_id)` index. The full suite passed with 247 passed, 4 skipped; a 10,000-document benchmark improved from a prior median of 16.73s to 2.41s.

Separately, `ledgerly/exporters/csv_export.py` now explicitly writes UTF-8, and `tests/test_csv_export.py` includes a `Zoë,東京` byte-level regression. All eight CSV tests pass, and MIME inspection reports UTF-8. This is a small, reviewable change but has not been committed. No Quebec tax investigation has started yet.

Two existing `tests/search/test_index.py` failures previously reported stale invoice descriptions; the later combined run passed, so this needs confirmation if encountered again.
